providers.emptyReason: tracker-intake — PRESENT_UNSCHEDULABLE: 7 input row(s) · 0 registered · 7 deferred · generated by lane-tracker triage (b), via lib/tracker/obligation-handoff.ts on 2026-08-31. Every row states what it needs first — this is the converting lane's work in progress, and NOT an absence of owner-reported work. |   DEFERRED NH27 — not yet schedulable, and the converting lane says why: an adapter for the live HTML route (the iCal route must not be the cadence source — it cannot go fresh); an observedChangeRateHours reading, which needs at least two observations of the HTML route; a declaredCycleHours if the town publishes a meeting schedule |   DEFERRED NH197 — not yet schedulable, and the converting lane says why: a decision on whether headroom is a property of the source or of the fetch window; an observedChangeRateHours reading once that is settled |   DEFERRED NH206 — not yet schedulable, and the converting lane says why: a route that can observe the snapshot's inputs rather than the snapshot; a declaredCycleHours or an observed rate |   DEFERRED NH115 — not yet schedulable, and the converting lane says why: an adapter for the roster page class; at least two observations before a rate can be derived |   DEFERRED NH244 — not yet schedulable, and the converting lane says why: the filing deadline as a declared cycle, which the state publishes; an adapter for the contest source |   DEFERRED PB04 — not yet schedulable, and the converting lane says why: a decision on whether the registry is a record or an index of records; a route that observes whichever it is |   DEFERRED OWN03-HORNE-SPLIT — not yet schedulable, and the converting lane says why: another representation of the same record — the known file is 60px against a 96px floor, so defeating the challenge would not yield a usable portrait; a route that is not the azed.gov image URL (door 3, an alternate first-party page, an archive, another custodian); permission is NOT the blocker: docs/sources.md already records azed.gov as ALLOWED at rung 4
